title: Sentence Specificity Scores for Collaborative Technical Documentation: A Domain-Transfer Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.01046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collaboration depends on shared context, and technical documentation is one way that context persists across people and AI teammates. Specificity, the amount and exactness of detail expressed in language, shapes what information documentation captures and how precisely that information is communicated. This work audits sentence-specificity scoring artifacts on technical documentation and tests whether scores applied only after generation help choose among fixed LLM-generated revisions. Across Wikipedia and three technical-documentation corpora, the fixed general-domain predictor SpeciTeller and the pinned post-publication author-repository implementation of Ko et al.'s target-adapted predictor produce different corpus orders and same-sentence rank agreement from -0.066 to 0.510. translated_title: 面向协同技术文档的句子特异性评分：一项领域迁移研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.01046v1 公告类型：交叉发布 摘要：协作依赖于共享的语境，而技术文档是这种语境在人与人之间以及人与AI队友之间得以延续的一种方式。特异性（即语言中表达细节的数量与精确程度）决定了文档所捕捉的信息内容以及信息传达的精确程度。这项工作对技术文档上的句子特异性评分工具进行了审计，并测试了仅在生成之后应用的评分是否有助于在固定的LLM生成修订版本之间做出选择。在维基百科和三个技术文档语料库上，固定的通用领域预测器 SpeciTeller 与 Ko 等人目标自适应预测器的固定发布后作者代码库实现产生了不同的语料库排序，且同一句子的排序一致性介于 -0.066 至 0.510 之间。严格的过滤和词元长度调整会改变这些模式，但无法使它们趋于一致。在 Gemma 数据集中，SpeciTeller 排序提升了方向有效的选择（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究审计了句子特异性评分工具在技术文档上的领域迁移表现，发现通用领域预测器与目标自适应预测器在不同语料库上产生不同的排序结果且句子级排序一致性有限，揭示了特异性评分器跨领域迁移时的显著差异。
en_tdlr: This study audits sentence-specificity scoring tools for domain transfer on technical documentation, finding that general-domain and target-adapted predictors produce different corpus orderings with limited same-sentence rank agreement, revealing significant discrepancies when specificity scorers are transferred across domains.
